title: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1975

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1975
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 1975
ORDINANCE I OF
1975
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1975
An Ordinance
further to amend the State Bank of
Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th January 1975]
No. F. 24 (I)/75-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 15th January 1975, is hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the State Bank of
Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. F. 24 (I)/75-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 15th January 1975, is hereby
published for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 17, Act XXXIII of 1956.-In
the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 (XXXIII of 1956), in section 17, in clause
(16), in sub clause (a), the words "for a period not exceeding three
months" shall be omitted.
